name: M4 Competition Dataset
description: A collection of 100,000 time series used in the M4 forecasting competition, spanning yearly, quarterly, monthly, weekly, daily, and hourly frequencies.
citation: Makridakis, S., Spiliotis, E., & Assimakopoulos, V. (2020). The M4 Competition: 100,000 time series and 61 forecasting methods. International Journal of Forecasting, 36(1), 54–74. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijforecast.2019.04.014
